# sigma_shared_templates (Data Source)

Lists workbook templates shared with this org via `GET /v2/shared_templates/shared_with_you`. Each entry includes a `share_id` you can plug into `sigma_shared_template_acceptance` to accept and import the template.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the share was created.
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `pending` (Boolean) True if not yet accepted by this org.
- `provider_organization_id` (String) Org that shared the template.
- `share_id` (String)
